name: aubade
description: Thin launcher for the aubade LSP server: semantic tokens and syntax diagnostics for the bundled tree-sitter grammars, plus relayed language-server intelligence.

aubade.path.description: Path to the aubade binary to launch. The extension runs `<aubade.path> lsp` per workspace folder; the binary must be a v1.1 or newer build.

aubade.diagnostics.disabledLanguages.markdownDescription: Language IDs for which aubade suppresses its own diagnostics (example: `["go"]`). Use this for languages where a dedicated language-server extension already publishes diagnostics, so squiggles are not duplicated.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
